# The documented university graphs of setup.sql, without their property options, which the
# emulator does not support. Their measures aggregate expressions, combine aggregates with scalar
# operations, count distinct values and derive from other measures; AGG evaluates each aggregate
# once per key.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/graph-measures.md
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(
  SELECT AS STRUCT College_college_name, AGG(Department_total_budget) AS college_budget,
    AGG(Course_course_count) AS total_courses
  FROM GRAPH_EXPAND('scalar_graph.SchoolGraph') GROUP BY College_college_name ORDER BY 1));
=> "[{\"College_college_name\":\"College of Arts\",\"college_budget\":200000,\"total_courses\":1},{\"College_college_name\":\"College of Engineering\",\"college_budget\":900000,\"total_courses\":3}]"

# The other measures of each college, from the documented rows and definitions: the courses of
# Engineering have 3, 4 and 3 credits, and the one of Arts 2.
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(
  SELECT AS STRUCT College_college_name, ROUND(AGG(Department_budget_with_overhead), 2) AS overhead,
    AGG(Course_avg_credits) AS avg_credits, AGG(Course_major_course_count) AS major_courses,
    AGG(Course_computed_avg_credits) AS computed_avg_credits
  FROM GRAPH_EXPAND('scalar_graph.SchoolGraph') GROUP BY College_college_name ORDER BY 1));
=> "[{\"College_college_name\":\"College of Arts\",\"overhead\":220000,\"avg_credits\":2,\"major_courses\":0,\"computed_avg_credits\":2},{\"College_college_name\":\"College of Engineering\",\"overhead\":990000,\"avg_credits\":3.3333333333333335,\"major_courses\":3,\"computed_avg_credits\":3.3333333333333335}]"

# The documented hierarchical query reads measures inside nested structs.
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(
  SELECT AS STRUCT DeptCourse.Department.dept_name AS department_name,
    DeptCourse.Department.CollegeDept.College.college_name,
    AGG(DeptCourse.Department.total_budget) AS total_budget, AGG(course_count) AS total_courses,
    AGG(computed_avg_credits) AS computed_avg_credits
  FROM GRAPH_EXPAND('scalar_graph.SchoolGraph', start_node => 'Course', flatten_results => FALSE)
  GROUP BY department_name, college_name ORDER BY 1));
=> "[{\"department_name\":\"Computer Science\",\"college_name\":\"College of Engineering\",\"total_budget\":500000,\"total_courses\":2,\"computed_avg_credits\":3.5},{\"department_name\":\"Fine Arts\",\"college_name\":\"College of Arts\",\"total_budget\":200000,\"total_courses\":1,\"computed_avg_credits\":2},{\"department_name\":\"Mechanical Engineering\",\"college_name\":\"College of Engineering\",\"total_budget\":400000,\"total_courses\":1,\"computed_avg_credits\":3}]"

# A measure's expression inside the aggregate is evaluated for every expanded row, so the course
# without a department is averaged in as a department with a budget of 0; the same expression as
# a property is evaluated on the department rows, which exclude that course.
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(AGG(Department_avg_budget_inline) AS inline,
  ROUND(AGG(Department_avg_budget_property), 2) AS property))
FROM GRAPH_EXPAND('scalar_graph.SchoolGraphWithOrphan');
=> "{\"inline\":275000,\"property\":366666.67}"

# Joining the expansions of the documented graph's two root node tables on their shared
# department aggregates each measure at its own grain.
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(
  SELECT AS STRUCT C.College_college_name, AGG(C.Course_course_count) AS total_courses,
    AGG(I.Instructor_total_salary) AS total_faculty_salary
  FROM GRAPH_EXPAND('scalar_graph.SchoolGraphMultiRoot', start_node => 'Course') AS C
  INNER JOIN GRAPH_EXPAND('scalar_graph.SchoolGraphMultiRoot', start_node => 'Instructor') AS I
    ON C.Department_dept_id = I.Department_dept_id
  GROUP BY C.College_college_name ORDER BY 1));
=> "[{\"College_college_name\":\"College of Arts\",\"total_courses\":1,\"total_faculty_salary\":90000},{\"College_college_name\":\"College of Engineering\",\"total_courses\":3,\"total_faculty_salary\":345000}]"

# The documented restrictions on measure expressions.
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH scalar_graph.MeasureGroupBy
  NODE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureCourse KEY (course_id)
    PROPERTIES (course_id, credits, dept_id, MEASURE(SUM(MAX(credits) GROUP BY dept_id)) AS total));
=> error:
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH scalar_graph.MeasureNestedGroupBy
  NODE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureCourse KEY (course_id)
    PROPERTIES (course_id, credits, dept_id,
      MEASURE(SUM(credits) + AVG(SUM(credits) GROUP BY dept_id)) AS total));
=> error:
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH scalar_graph.MeasureWindow
  NODE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureCourse KEY (course_id)
    PROPERTIES (course_id, credits, MEASURE(SUM(credits) OVER ()) AS total));
=> error:
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH scalar_graph.MeasureSubquery
  NODE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureCourse KEY (course_id)
    PROPERTIES (course_id, credits, MEASURE(SUM(credits) + (SELECT 1)) AS total));
=> error:
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH scalar_graph.MeasureWhere
  NODE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureCourse KEY (course_id)
    PROPERTIES (course_id, credits, MEASURE(SUM(credits) + SUM(credits WHERE credits > 2)) AS total));
=> error:
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH scalar_graph.MeasureOutsideAggregate
  NODE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureCourse KEY (course_id)
    PROPERTIES (course_id, credits, MEASURE(SUM(credits) + credits) AS total));
=> error:
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH scalar_graph.MeasureCycle
  NODE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureCourse KEY (course_id)
    PROPERTIES (course_id, credits, MEASURE(AGG(b) + 1) AS a, MEASURE(AGG(a) + 1) AS b));
=> error:
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH scalar_graph.MeasureAggDistinct
  NODE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureCourse KEY (course_id)
    PROPERTIES (course_id, credits, MEASURE(SUM(credits)) AS a, MEASURE(AGG(DISTINCT a)) AS b));
=> error:

# Observed with tools/bqanswers. L's ids 1 and 2 have the same amount, 100, and 3 has none; the
# rows 5 and 6 of S match no L.
#
# DISTINCT applies to the values of distinct keys.
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH scalar_graph.MeasureDistinctValues
  NODE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureAmountRows AS S,
    scalar_graph.MeasureAmounts AS L PROPERTIES (id, a AS amount, b,
      MEASURE(SUM(DISTINCT amount)) AS sum_distinct,
      MEASURE(COUNT(DISTINCT amount)) AS count_distinct, MEASURE(AVG(DISTINCT amount)) AS avg_distinct))
  EDGE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureAmountRows AS SL SOURCE KEY (lid) REFERENCES L (id)
    DESTINATION KEY (id) REFERENCES S (id));
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(AGG(L_sum_distinct) AS sum_distinct,
  AGG(L_count_distinct) AS count_distinct, AGG(L_avg_distinct) AS avg_distinct))
FROM GRAPH_EXPAND('scalar_graph.MeasureDistinctValues');
=> "{\"sum_distinct\":100,\"count_distinct\":1,\"avg_distinct\":100}"

# The expanded rows without a match share one key, NULL, so an expression evaluated for them
# counts once.
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH scalar_graph.MeasureUnmatchedRows
  NODE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureAmountRows AS S,
    scalar_graph.MeasureAmounts AS L PROPERTIES (id, a AS amount, b,
      MEASURE(AVG(COALESCE(amount, 0))) AS avg_inline,
      MEASURE(COUNT(COALESCE(amount, 0))) AS count_inline,
      MEASURE(SUM(COALESCE(amount, 0) + 1)) AS sum_inline, MEASURE(MIN(COALESCE(b, -1))) AS min_inline))
  EDGE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureAmountRows AS SL SOURCE KEY (lid) REFERENCES L (id)
    DESTINATION KEY (id) REFERENCES S (id));
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(AGG(L_avg_inline) AS avg_inline, AGG(L_count_inline) AS count_inline,
  AGG(L_sum_inline) AS sum_inline, AGG(L_min_inline) AS min_inline))
FROM GRAPH_EXPAND('scalar_graph.MeasureUnmatchedRows');
=> "{\"avg_inline\":50,\"count_inline\":4,\"sum_inline\":204,\"min_inline\":-1}"

# Derived measures that combine AGG with other aggregates and change the result type.
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH scalar_graph.MeasureDerivedMixed
  NODE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureAmountRows AS S,
    scalar_graph.MeasureAmounts AS L PROPERTIES (id, a AS amount, b,
      MEASURE(SUM(amount)) AS total, MEASURE(AGG(total) + SUM(b)) AS with_sum,
      MEASURE(AGG(total) / 3) AS divided, MEASURE(AGG(with_sum) * COUNT(DISTINCT b)) AS nested))
  EDGE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureAmountRows AS SL SOURCE KEY (lid) REFERENCES L (id)
    DESTINATION KEY (id) REFERENCES S (id));
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(AGG(L_with_sum) AS with_sum, AGG(L_divided) AS divided,
  AGG(L_nested) AS nested))
FROM GRAPH_EXPAND('scalar_graph.MeasureDerivedMixed');
=> "{\"with_sum\":206,\"divided\":66.666666666666671,\"nested\":618}"

# A derived measure grouped by the root table's key.
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH scalar_graph.MeasureDerivedGrouped
  NODE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureAmountRows AS S,
    scalar_graph.MeasureAmounts AS L PROPERTIES (id, a AS amount, b,
      MEASURE(MAX(amount)) AS high, MEASURE(MIN(b)) AS low,
      MEASURE(AGG(high) - AGG(low)) AS spread))
  EDGE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureAmountRows AS SL SOURCE KEY (lid) REFERENCES L (id)
    DESTINATION KEY (id) REFERENCES S (id));
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT S_id AS id, AGG(L_spread) AS spread
  FROM GRAPH_EXPAND('scalar_graph.MeasureDerivedGrouped') GROUP BY S_id ORDER BY 1));
=> "[{\"id\":1,\"spread\":99},{\"id\":2,\"spread\":99},{\"id\":3,\"spread\":98},{\"id\":4,\"spread\":null},{\"id\":5,\"spread\":null},{\"id\":6,\"spread\":null}]"

# BigQuery rejects a measure over a column that is not a property, here `a`, whose property is
# `amount`, aggregate functions other than SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX, COUNT and AGG, and measures without
# an aggregate of a property.
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH scalar_graph.MeasureColumn
  NODE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureAmountRows AS S,
    scalar_graph.MeasureAmounts AS L PROPERTIES (id, a AS amount, b,
      MEASURE(SUM(a)) AS m))
  EDGE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureAmountRows AS SL SOURCE KEY (lid) REFERENCES L (id)
    DESTINATION KEY (id) REFERENCES S (id));
=> error: Columns are not supported in graph measure property expressions at [4:19]
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH scalar_graph.MeasureCountOne
  NODE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureAmountRows AS S,
    scalar_graph.MeasureAmounts AS L PROPERTIES (id, a AS amount, b,
      MEASURE(COUNT(1)) AS m))
  EDGE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureAmountRows AS SL SOURCE KEY (lid) REFERENCES L (id)
    DESTINATION KEY (id) REFERENCES S (id));
=> error: Invalid measure expression 'm'. A measure expression must contain at least one aggregate function referencing a graph property.
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH scalar_graph.MeasureSumOfConstant
  NODE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureAmountRows AS S,
    scalar_graph.MeasureAmounts AS L PROPERTIES (id, a AS amount, b,
      MEASURE(SUM(1)) AS m))
  EDGE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureAmountRows AS SL SOURCE KEY (lid) REFERENCES L (id)
    DESTINATION KEY (id) REFERENCES S (id));
=> error: Invalid measure expression 'm'. A measure expression must contain at least one aggregate function referencing a graph property.
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH scalar_graph.MeasureCountOfConstantExpression
  NODE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureAmountRows AS S,
    scalar_graph.MeasureAmounts AS L PROPERTIES (id, a AS amount, b,
      MEASURE(COUNT(1 + 1)) AS m))
  EDGE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureAmountRows AS SL SOURCE KEY (lid) REFERENCES L (id)
    DESTINATION KEY (id) REFERENCES S (id));
=> error: Invalid measure expression 'm'. A measure expression must contain at least one aggregate function referencing a graph property.
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH scalar_graph.MeasureWithoutAggregate
  NODE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureAmountRows AS S,
    scalar_graph.MeasureAmounts AS L PROPERTIES (id, a AS amount, b,
      MEASURE(1) AS m))
  EDGE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureAmountRows AS SL SOURCE KEY (lid) REFERENCES L (id)
    DESTINATION KEY (id) REFERENCES S (id));
=> error: Invalid measure expression 'm'. A measure expression must contain at least one aggregate function referencing a graph property.
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH scalar_graph.MeasureCountif
  NODE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureAmountRows AS S,
    scalar_graph.MeasureAmounts AS L PROPERTIES (id, a AS amount, b,
      MEASURE(COUNTIF(amount > 1)) AS m))
  EDGE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureAmountRows AS SL SOURCE KEY (lid) REFERENCES L (id)
    DESTINATION KEY (id) REFERENCES S (id));
=> error: Aggregate function countif is not allowed in a measure expression in BigQuery.
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH scalar_graph.MeasureAnyValue
  NODE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureAmountRows AS S,
    scalar_graph.MeasureAmounts AS L PROPERTIES (id, a AS amount, b,
      MEASURE(ANY_VALUE(amount)) AS m))
  EDGE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureAmountRows AS SL SOURCE KEY (lid) REFERENCES L (id)
    DESTINATION KEY (id) REFERENCES S (id));
=> error: Aggregate function any_value is not allowed in a measure expression in BigQuery.
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH scalar_graph.MeasureArrayAgg
  NODE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureAmountRows AS S,
    scalar_graph.MeasureAmounts AS L PROPERTIES (id, a AS amount, b,
      MEASURE(ARRAY_AGG(amount IGNORE NULLS)) AS m))
  EDGE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureAmountRows AS SL SOURCE KEY (lid) REFERENCES L (id)
    DESTINATION KEY (id) REFERENCES S (id));
=> error: Aggregate function array_agg is not allowed in a measure expression in BigQuery.

# BigQuery accepts a measure that aggregates a property beside an aggregate of none, as in the
# graphs of setup.sql, but GRAPH_EXPAND then fails on that aggregate as a name: "Invalid
# table-valued function GRAPH_EXPAND", then on its own line the name and the call's location.
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(AGG(L_m) AS m)) AS result FROM GRAPH_EXPAND('scalar_graph.MeasureCountOneBeside')
=> error contains: Unrecognized name: `L_COUNT(1)` at [1:61]
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(AGG(L_m) AS m)) AS result FROM GRAPH_EXPAND('scalar_graph.MeasureSumOfConstantBeside')
=> error contains: Unrecognized name: `L_SUM(1)` at [1:61]
